title: A leader's note to all their Circle members has a one-click unsubscribe and skips people who blocked them

source.ref: Email and messaging check 2026-11-18 (thread: Check every email and message system)

detail:
2026-11-18: leader-send emails every member of every Circle a leader runs with only a Message-ID header, no unsubscribe link or List-Unsubscribe header, on the transactional lane, and without isBlockedBetween (lib/comms/bulk-dm.ts does check it). A list fan-out with no one-click opt-out breaks the Gmail and Yahoo bulk rules and CAN-SPAM, and a member who blocked the leader still gets mail. Done when the send carries listUnsubscribeHeaders with a footer link, rides the bulk lane, and skips blocked pairs.

lib/comms/leader-send.ts now sends each Circle member a lifecycle List-Unsubscribe (RFC 8058 one-click) plus a footer link, enqueues on the bulk lane with the outbox drip, and skips any member in a block pair with the leader (isBlockedBetween, fail closed). Focused tests in lib/comms/leader-send.test.ts.

verify.note: Passes once a leader note to their Circles carries List-Unsubscribe and checks isBlockedBetween.
